parts.text: Find the make and production time of the cars that were produced in the earliest year?

tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `car_makers` (
  `Id` INT(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  `Maker` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  `FullName` VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  `Country` INT(32) NOT NULL
)
tables.name: car_makers

tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `car_names` (
  `MakeId` INT(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  `Model` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  `Make` VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL
)
tables.name: car_names

tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `cars_data` (
  `Id` INT(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  `MPG` DECIMAL(10,2),
  `Cylinders` INT(32) NOT NULL,
  `Edispl` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `Horsepower` INT(32),
  `Weight` INT(32) NOT NULL,
  `Accelerate` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `Year` INT(32) NOT NULL
)
tables.name: cars_data

tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `model_list` (
  `ModelId` INT(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  `Maker` INT(32) NOT NULL,
  `Model` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL
)
tables.name: model_list

arguments.sql:
SELECT cn.Make, cd.Year
FROM cars_data cd
JOIN car_names cn ON cd.Id = cn.MakeId
WHERE cd.Year = (SELECT MIN(Year) FROM cars_data)

parts.text:
The earliest production year in the dataset is **1970**. There are **35 cars** produced in that year. Here they are:

| Make | Year |
|---|---|
| chevrolet chevelle malibu | 1970 |
| buick skylark 320 | 1970 |
| plymouth satellite | 1970 |
| amc rebel sst | 1970 |

| amc hornet | 1970 |
| ford maverick | 1970 |

| peugeot 504 | 1970 |

| amc gremlin | 1970 |

All 35 cars were produced in **1970**, which is the earliest year in the dataset. The makes span a variety of manufacturers including American brands (Chevrolet, Ford, Plymouth, Dodge, AMC, Buick, Pontiac) as well as international brands (Toyota, Datsun, Volkswagen, Peugeot, Audi, Saab, BMW, Citroen).
